title: content_learnings
description: Memory block written by Agent 6.3 (Optimization Engine), the Layer 6 closed-loop optimizer. It turns measured performance into a small, prioritized set of optimization actions (A/B conclusions, scale up/down, creative/copy/audience retunes, budget reallocations) and maintains the durable, accumulating learnings ledger that Layer 3 (Content Planning) and Layer 4 (Production) read on the next cycle. Reads: performance_history (6.1, primary) and the prior content_learnings (its own block). Human gate: bounded automation — gate_status is 'auto_approved' when every action is bounded (incl. budget reallocations <=20% of source that don't raise total spend) and 'pending_review' when any action requires a human (any reallocation >20% of source or any total-spend increase).

action_id.description: Stable id for this optimization action (e.g. opt-2026-08-ab-meta-cpl).

action_type.description: What kind of optimization this is. Only budget_reallocate / spend-increasing scale_up can require a human.

target_ids.description: Specific campaign/channel/creative/audience/experiment id(s) the action applies to.

evidence.description: The metric(s) from performance_history that justify the action, quoted with the KPI comparison and the sample relied on. No evidence -> no action.

expected_effect.description: The KPI expected to move and the direction/magnitude (e.g. 'blended CPL -10-15% next cycle').

auto_apply.description: True when this action is bounded and applies without a human.

requires_human.description: True when this action is a binding spend decision (>20% reallocation / increases total spend / breaches ceiling). Exactly one of auto_apply / requires_human is true.

feeds.description: Which downstream layer(s) consume this action/learning.

rationale.description: EN — one or two sentences explaining the decision.

from.description: Source campaign/channel id the budget moves out of.

to.description: Destination campaign/channel id the budget moves into.

pct_of_source_budget.description: amount_usd / source's current budget, as a fraction (0.20 = 20%). The 20% bounded line is on this value.

increases_total_spend.description: True if this move raises total spend rather than being a pure shift. Any True forces requires_human.

requires_human.description: True when pct_of_source_budget > 0.20, or increases_total_spend is true, or it breaches the client's budget ceiling.

rationale.description: EN — why the money should move.

learning_id.description: Stable id for this durable learning (e.g. lrn-mx-edu-carousel-proof).

lesson.description: One clear, reusable sentence an L3/L4 agent can act on next cycle.

evidence.description: The metric basis for the lesson.

first_observed.description: Cycle (YYYY-MM) the lesson was first observed.

reconfirmed.description: Cycle (YYYY-MM) a later cycle reconfirmed it (promotes confidence). Null until reconfirmed.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this optimization run was generated.

gate_status.description: Gate posture of this agent's OWN output. 'auto_approved' when every action is bounded; 'pending_review' when any action requires a human (reallocation >20% of source or any total-spend increase).

cycle_month.description: Marketing cycle this optimization covers, YYYY-MM. Null if not derivable from the upstream block.

source_block.description: Which upstream block the optimization was computed from. 'none' when no performance data was available.

optimization_actions.description: The prioritized optimization action set for the cycle (typically 3-8). May be empty only when there is nothing to optimize (source_block = 'none').

budget_reallocations.description: The money moves proposed this cycle, each with its 20%-rule gating. Empty when no budget moves are warranted.

learnings.description: The durable, accumulating, de-duplicated learnings ledger read by Layer 3/4 next cycle.

open_hypotheses.description: Tests still running or sequenced for a later cycle (so they aren't re-launched).

retired_learnings.description: Learnings a later cycle contradicted, moved here with the reason.

notes.description: EN — evidence base, samples relied on, seasonality/market caveats, what was carried forward, empty-cycle reason.
